channel.title: Novera AI tool guides and updates
channel.description: Discover thoughtfully selected AI tools, clearly organized across 12 useful categories.

item.title: 5 New AI Tools to Explore — Week of August 24, 2026
item.description: An editorially reviewed look at five newly discovered AI tools across coding, productivity, video, and image creation, with verified capabilities, pricing models, and links to detailed listings.

item.title: Kith
item.description: Kith is an AI clinical workspace for therapists that provides ambient transcription, clinically specific SOAP notes, online-session support, scheduling, and reminders.

item.title: Doodle AI
item.description: Doodle AI creates hand-drawn avatars, sticker packs, portraits, collages, and other illustrated variations from an uploaded photo or a character description.

item.title: Twing
item.description: Twing is a coordination layer for engineering teams using multiple AI coding agents, designed to expose duplicated work and conflicting changes before they reach review.

item.title: dmx
item.description: dmx is an open-source MCP server that adds specifications, plans, validation policies, persistent state, and explicit human approval gates to AI-assisted development workflows.

item.title: H3Max
item.description: H3Max is a browser-based workspace for creating 5–15 second AI videos from written directions or source images, with prompt expansion and optional first- and end-frame controls.
